instruction: A clean studio photograph with a full-body shot captures two women dancing in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain, light gray background. On the left, the woman with curly afro hair in a mauve button-up dress (R1) leans back with her eyes closed and a serene expression. On the right, the woman with short brown hair in a striped shirt and white trousers (R2) leans back against her. The curly-haired woman and the brown-haired woman are positioned back-to-back, supporting each other's weight as they stretch their arms outward and upward in a joyful dance pose. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the neutral color palette.
